description:
[Interviews] Change the state of an interview/position (e.g. open, closed).

Changes the lifecycle status of an interview or position (draft, active, archived, preparing, completed, deleted) and/or manages its embed key. Provide at least one of `status` or `is_embedded`.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

is_embedded.description: Controls iframe embedding of the interview on an external page. When true, ensures an embed key exists (returns embed_id/embed_signing_key, used to authenticate/sign the iframe embed). When false, removes the embed keys (disables embedding). Where it runs depends on the type: interviews, assessments and interview role-plays embed on the interview portal (`https://<interview portal domain>/embed?embed_id=...`); coaching sessions and coaching personas embed on the consumer (coaching) portal (`https://<coaching portal domain>/embed?embed_id=...`, a link built on the interview portal is forwarded there). A signed coaching embed (name, email, signature) signs the visitor in as a learner of that portal, and the session is charged to the merchant's interview credits on completion, not to the learner's coaching credits; it cannot start while the merchant has none.

position_id.description: Interview definition id or position id whose state should change.

name: set_interview_state

result.description: Returns `{ embed_id, embed_signing_key }` when an embed key was created/returned (is_embedded=true), otherwise `{ success: true }`.

title: Change interview state
